import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundlePullback
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivLocallyClosed
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Restrict

/-!
# The open invertibility locus

The union of the affine open subsets on which a module is trivial of rank one
is the largest open subscheme on which it is an invertible sheaf. This open
is distinct from the locally closed rank-one flattening stratum: arbitrary
base change can make a module invertible without its image lying in this open.

The open locus supplies the total-space input for the proper whole-fibre open
used by the Grassmannian construction of the divisor scheme.
-/

noncomputable section

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The largest open subset on which `M` is locally trivial of rank one. -/
def lineBundleOpen (M : X.Modules) : X.Opens :=
  ⨆ (U : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U)
    (_ : Nonempty (M.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)), U

/-- A point belongs to the open invertibility locus exactly when it has an
affine trivializing neighborhood. -/
theorem mem_lineBundleOpen_iff (M : X.Modules) (x : X) :
    x ∈ lineBundleOpen M ↔ ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      Nonempty (M.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) := by
  simp only [lineBundleOpen, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, ha, ht, hx⟩
    exact ⟨U, hx, ha, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨U, hx, ha, ht⟩
    exact ⟨U, ha, ht, hx⟩

/-- A morphism landing in the open invertibility locus pulls `M` back to an
invertible sheaf. -/
theorem isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_lineBundleOpen
    (M : X.Modules) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : Set.range f.base ⊆ lineBundleOpen M) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback f).obj M) := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U, hyU, _, ⟨eM⟩⟩ :=
    (mem_lineBundleOpen_iff M (f.base y)).mp (hf ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  have hyU' : y ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ U := hyU
  obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hyV, hVU⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hyU'
  refine ⟨V, hyV, hVaff, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  let g : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme := f.resLE U V hVU
  have hg : g ≫ U.ι = V.ι ≫ f := Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι f hVU
  haveI : (TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g.base).Final :=
    CategoryTheory.final_of_representablyFlat _
  let eUnit := asIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)
  exact (restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).app ((pullback f).obj M) ≪≫
    (pullbackComp V.ι f).app M ≪≫ (pullbackCongr hg.symm).app M ≪≫
    (pullbackComp g U.ι).symm.app M ≪≫
    (pullback g).mapIso ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).symm.app M) ≪≫
    (pullback g).mapIso eM ≪≫
    eUnit

/-- The module restricted to its open invertibility locus is invertible. -/
theorem lineBundleOpen_isLocallyTrivial (M : X.Modules) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback (lineBundleOpen M).ι).obj M) :=
  isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_lineBundleOpen M _ (by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι])

/-- An open immersion on which the module is invertible lands in its open
invertibility locus. -/
theorem range_subset_lineBundleOpen_of_isLocallyTrivial_pullback
    (M : X.Modules) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (hf : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback f).obj M)) :
    Set.range f.base ⊆ lineBundleOpen M := by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, hVaff, ⟨eV⟩⟩ := hf y
  apply (mem_lineBundleOpen_iff M (f.base y)).mpr
  refine ⟨f ''ᵁ V, ⟨y, hyV, rfl⟩, hVaff.image_of_isOpenImmersion f, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  let g := (f.isoImage V).inv
  have hg : g ≫ (V.ι ≫ f) = (f ''ᵁ V).ι := f.isoImage_inv_ι V
  haveI : (TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g.base).Final :=
    CategoryTheory.final_of_representablyFlat _
  let eUnit := asIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom)
  exact (restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ''ᵁ V).ι).app M ≪≫
    (pullbackCongr hg.symm).app M ≪≫
    (pullbackComp g (V.ι ≫ f)).symm.app M ≪≫
    (pullback g).mapIso ((pullbackComp V.ι f).symm.app M) ≪≫
    (pullback g).mapIso
      ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).symm.app ((pullback f).obj M)) ≪≫
    (pullback g).mapIso eV ≪≫
    eUnit

/-- Maximality of the open invertibility locus among all open restrictions. -/
theorem le_lineBundleOpen_iff (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) :
    U ≤ lineBundleOpen M ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback U.ι).obj M) := by
  constructor
  · intro hU
    apply isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_lineBundleOpen M U.ι
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact hU
  · intro hU
    have h := range_subset_lineBundleOpen_of_isLocallyTrivial_pullback M U.ι hU
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at h
    exact h

attribute [local instance] moduleSectionBasicOpen isScalarTowerSectionBasicOpen

/-- For a finitely presented module on an affine chart, a free stalk of rank
one spreads to an affine trivializing neighborhood. -/
theorem mem_lineBundleOpen_of_free_rank_one_localized_sections
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (V : X.affineOpens)
    [Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(M, V.1)] (x : V.1)
    [Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal)
      (LocalizedModule (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V.1))]
    (hrank : Module.finrank (Localization.AtPrime (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal)
      (LocalizedModule (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V.1)) = 1) :
    x.1 ∈ lineBundleOpen M := by
  let p := V.2.primeIdealOf x
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfree, hrankf⟩ :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers p.asIdeal.primeCompl
      (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V.1))
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
  have hx : x.1 ∈ X.basicOpen f := by
    rw [← V.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen f]
    exact ⟨p, hf, V.2.fromSpec_primeIdealOf x⟩
  haveI := hfree
  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_basicOpen M V.2 f
  obtain ⟨hfr, hrk⟩ := Module.free_and_finrank_of_isLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
    Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(M, X.basicOpen f) (restrictBasicOpenₗ M f)
  haveI := hfr
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(M, X.basicOpen f) :=
    Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (restrictBasicOpenₗ M f)
  haveI : Nontrivial Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :=
    PrimeSpectrum.nontrivial ((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x.1, hx⟩)
  have hdim : Module.finrank Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(M, X.basicOpen f) = 1 :=
    hrk.trans (hrankf.trans hrank)
  let b := Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(M, X.basicOpen f) hdim
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := pullback_isFreeOfRank_of_sectionsEquiv M (V.2.basicOpen f) 1
    b.equivFun.symm
  have eUnit : SheafOfModules.free (R := (X.basicOpen f).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
      (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (X.basicOpen f).toScheme.ringCatSheaf :=
    Limits.coproductUniqueIso (fun _ : ULift.{u} (Fin 1) =>
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.basicOpen f).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
  exact (mem_lineBundleOpen_iff M x.1).mpr ⟨X.basicOpen f, hx, V.2.basicOpen f,
    ⟨(restrictFunctorIsoPullback (X.basicOpen f).ι).app M ≪≫ e ≪≫ eUnit⟩⟩

/-- The noetherian coherent version of rank-one stalk spreading. -/
theorem mem_lineBundleOpen_of_free_rank_one_localized_sections_of_isFinitePresentation
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (V : X.affineOpens) (x : V.1)
    [Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal)
      (LocalizedModule (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V.1))]
    (hrank : Module.finrank (Localization.AtPrime (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal)
      (LocalizedModule (V.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V.1)) = 1) :
    x.1 ∈ lineBundleOpen M := by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(X, V.1) Γ(M, V.1) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation M V
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(M, V.1) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite Γ(X, V.1) Γ(M, V.1)
  exact mem_lineBundleOpen_of_free_rank_one_localized_sections M V x hrank

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
